Project reference 2023-2-NO01-KA210-ADU-000181659 . KA210-ADU · Small-scale partnerships in adult education. The project ran from 01-01-2024 to 31-12-2024.
Data protection
This website does not use cookies, analytics or third-party tracking. Fonts are served from this site's own server, so no request goes to a third-party font provider. There is no user account and no login.
Accessibility settings
If you change the accessibility settings (text size, contrast and the like), your choices are kept in your browser's local storage so that they stay the same from page to page. They stay on your device and are never sent to us. To remove them, choose “Reset to default” or clear this site's data in your browser.
Names in the forum
Questions in the Peer-Learning Forum are composite examples drawn from mentoring practice rather than a record of one identifiable person, and the names on them are pseudonyms. Replies signed Mentoring team or Project team come from the project partners. Anyone writing in chooses their own name, and we ask that nobody uses someone else's.
Server logs and email
The web server keeps standard access logs, which include IP addresses, for the purpose of operating and securing the site. If you write to the coordinator by email, that correspondence is handled by Mentorung under its own retention practice.
The e-learning platform linked from this site is a separate system with its own accounts and its own privacy terms. This notice does not cover it.
External links
DigiMentor is not responsible for the content of external websites linked from these pages.

På Bondens marked kan du kjøpe mat direkte fra bonden. Utvalget varierer med naturens sesonger og regionen du bor i. Alt er småskala og lokalt produsert, laget av den du handler med. Som oftest vil du finne ost, kjøtt, fisk og vilt, bakervarer, honning, frukt, bær og grønnsaker.
I år er det 20 år siden Bondens marked ble startet i Norge. Jubileet vil markeres på ulike måter gjennom høsten.
Det arrangeres Bondes marked i alle landets fylker, hyppigheten avhenger av sesong og lokale forhold. I tillegg til de vanlige markedene over hele landet arrangerer Bondens marked i år "Bondens matfest" på Youngstorget i Oslo 15.-16. september.
